# Hermes Labs plugin catalog

> Canonical, generated multi-host distribution catalog for Hermes Labs agent plugins.

Authoritative input: `catalog.json`.

Generated outputs:

- `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` — Claude Code namespace `hermes-labs`
- `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` — Codex namespace `hermes-labs`
- `.github/plugin/marketplace.json` — GitHub Copilot namespace `hermes-labs-copilot`

Product implementations remain in the repositories named by each catalog
entry. Every source is HTTPS and pinned to a full commit. Compatibility
statuses distinguish verified runtime behavior from a preserved but
uncertified listing.

Build and verify:

```bash
npm run generate
npm test
npm run verify
npm run verify:network
```

Canonical repository: https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/plugins
